bias.en: Bearish · back above the Jul 17 low
bias.zh: 偏空 · 重回 7月17日低点上方

read.en: Sandisk rose 5.5% on Oct 19 to $1,371.12, trading between $1,357.64 and $1,407. It is below the falling 5-day ($1,390.2), 10-day ($1,498.2), 30-day ($1,640.5) and 100-day ($1,642.2) averages, and above the rising 200-day ($1,216.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 6 ($1,603.75), and RSI is 36.

The close reclaimed the $1,325 Jul 17 low, which is support again, while the day's high of $1,407 stalled at the Oct 13–14 lows. Resistance is $1,390–1,407 (5-day average, Oct 13–14 lows), then $1,470 (former floor) and $1,498 (10-day). Support is $1,325, then $1,276 (Oct 15 low) and $1,216 (200-day). A close above $1,407 would target $1,470; a close below $1,276 would open $1,216.

r.en: Oct 13 and Oct 14 lows; 5-day average $1,390; Oct 19 high $1,407
